text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> gave it her all and cleared the 1st Stage 
at the top of the field. Carrying this 
momentum, she aims to clear the 2nd Stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Ryoka Tsurugi and Sonon Elfie 
were conducting a review. The event itself 
was a huge success with high satisfaction 
among the racers, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That passion has yet to reach the general 
public. Ryoka Tsurugi resolves to 
definitely find a breakthrough before the 
2nd Stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the 1st Stage, a senior 
Trainer approached me, asking to help out 
with running the U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the year-end Qualifiers Stage 
2, something was steadily beginning to 
move—
